desc: Get food on the table quicker thanks to a fast preheat oven. In just 7 minutes*, you have a perfectly preheated oven. *Preheats oven in just 7 minutes, bake mode to preheat beep, 350 degrees, one standard rack..Five powerful gas burners make for an efficient cooking experience on this expansive and flexible cooktop..47 1/4 H x 30 W x 27 7/8 D
hl: Five powerful gas burners make for an efficient cooking experience on this expansive and flexible cooktop.
Boil water faster with a 15,000 BTU Power Boil element that delivers high heat for quick boiling.
A large cooking surface gives you extra room for pots and pans of all sizes and lets cookware move easily from burner to burner.
Custom cookware and griddles easily fit on this powerful fifth central oval burner that offers a flexible cooking solution.
Prepare your delicate dishes over the low, even heat of this precise simmer burner.
Save time and effort by using the self-cleaning function for deep clean situations, or enjoy frequent cleanings without the need for kits or extra steps thanks to the steam clean oven function.
